SPECIFICATION FOR DEFLECTION COIL UP USED W~1Tl-l TV PICTURE TUBES
PART IV TYPE DCUZS FOR 310 mm AND PICTURE TUBES 340 mm

1. General - This standard shall be read in conjunction with IS : 9187 (Part I)-1 979 ' deflection coil units used with TV picture tubes: Part I General requirements and tests' I. Type Designation XU2S'. This deflection coil unit shall be designated as `Deflection

DCU means deflection coil unit, 2 S represents TV picture tubes of sizes 310 mm and 340 mm, and denotes solid state circuitry.

2. Application -This deflection coil unit Type DCUZS is meant for use with a 310 n 1IO" to 114" monochrome picture tube in conjunction with : a) line output transformer used with TV picture tubes, type LCT2S for 310 mm and 34 tubes [see Indian Standard Specification for line output transformer used with _ Type LOT2S for 310 mm 340 mm TV picture tubes (under preparation)]; and b) linearity control unit used with TV picture tubes, type LCU2S for 310 mm and 34 tubes [see Indian Standard Specification for linearity control unit used with T' Types LCU2S for 310 mm and 340 mm TV picture tubes (under preparation)]. 3. Description - The saddle-shaped line deflection coils shall be mounted on moulc the deflection centre shall be well within the conical part of the picture tube. The fiek shall be wound on a ferrite yoke ring which is flarred so that the frame and line deflection The relative positions of the frame and line deflection coils are so adjusted that their fl angle to each other. The unit shall meet the self-extinguishing and non-dripping requir Standard safety requirements for mains operated electronic and related apparatus fo similar general use (under preparation). 4. 5. Mounting -The deflection unit shall be mounted as far forward as possible on the neck of the picture tube, so that it touches fhe cone. To orient the raster correctly, the unit may be rotated by hand on the neck of the picture tube with which it shall make a slip fit. A screw-tightened clamping ring shall permit it to be locked both axially and radially, in the desired position. 6.
